title: Alegia: el ayuntamiento baja a sus cimientos, y la pérgola de Txintxarri
description: docs/graphics.md § Seeing Gerard behind things, src/geo-scenery.ts `SINK`. Behind the town hall, where Marta's piano is, it and its neighbour come down to their foundations instead of opening a window; out in front on San Juan kalea they stand whole. Then the plan its foundations show up close, and the wisteria pergola whole and with Gerard under it (src/landmarks/pergola.ts). Run it with --gpu --scale 2.

steps.caption: Just arrived behind the town hall: it is coming down
Down to its foundations: the square, the pergola, the piano and Marta in full view
Out in front on San Juan kalea: the town hall stands whole, its arches and clock
